title: lane r2 SE: existential linkage lets a squash smuggle a second defect
description: Lane round 2. Lens: software-engineer (validator: SO). Owner: SO session. Defect: 'names no finding issue' is existential — a two-defect squash naming one finding passes both falsifiers with the second defect ungated; multi-commit baseline default undefined; squash can dangle the recorded baseline. Citations verified: contract:81, :83, :64. Proposed: resolved-candidate (one defect per fix commit — the one-divergence-per-dispatch rule Thermite's fixer proves upstream; multi-commit fixes carry the recorded baseline explicitly; re-record on history rewrite).

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: Fixed: one defect per fix commit (Thermite's one-divergence-per-dispatch rule); a two-defect commit is nonconformant; the falsifier adds the cross-check (evidence section naming one finding while the gate record shows another's tests); multi-commit fixes carry the explicit recorded baseline.
